planets.name: Kepler-1542 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1542 with a 3.95-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: Kepler-1542 b crosses its star every 3.95 days and is 0.76 times as wide as Earth, found in 2016.
text.introduction: Kepler-1542 b transits Kepler-1542 every 3.95 days and is 0.76 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MORTON_ET_AL__2016): pl_orbper 3.95116882, pl_radj 0.06780266, pl_bmassj 0.00114
